dynamic_line: 'The Eclipse has not claimed you yet. I will cut a way out. Stay close.' Beyond his shoulder, the darkness recoils from his blade.
'Survive first. Answers can wait.' He raises his sword, and a path opens through the dark.
'You brought him down. Even so, this place will devour what remains of you. Come with me, now.'

responses.text: Follow the Skull Knight out of the Eclipse.

dynamic_line: 'You escaped, but the Eclipse has marked you. Your hand is gone. What comes next is yours to decide.'

responses.text: How can I replace my hand?

dynamic_line: 'Craft the prosthetic arm cannon and its charge. Once the cannon is made, activate it from your inventory. The mount where your left hand used to be will hold it.'
